name: Inevitor
description: A stealthy one-way Monoist boarding pod that plunges along a free trajectory at thirty kilometers a second.

timeline.summary: The Monoist inevitors launch toward the Dawnsire, and Alpharael learns they will hit at thirty kilometers a second.
